quests.title: quarter to six at St Marys
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. I start at quarter to six and for a month the St Marys back lane has had somebody in it who is not waiting for bread. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the lane, from the door, no flash
I am not calling anyone until I am sure

quests.title: The Lane Light, St Marys
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. A light on that lane costs St Marys $34 and the landlord has said no twice, so we are doing it ourselves. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $34 and I will fit it myself
do not tell him where it came from

quests.title: Flour Run, St Marys
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The flour for St Marys comes off a truck at quarter to six and last grand final week the truck came and the flour did not. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: ride out to Werrington where the load is made up
the pallet with our name on it, if it exists

quests.title: The Loading Zone, St Marys
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The St Marys loading zone has had a car in it at quarter to six every morning this week and the driver waits in it, which makes it worse. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the one who says he is only a minute
and the ticket I got, off him

quests.title: The Sourdough Sign, St Marys
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Somebody two doors down from St Marys put up a sign on grand final week that says the same six words as ours, in the same order. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: walk down and read it properly
both signs if you can get them in one frame
tell me I am not imagining it

quests.title: The Old Site, St Marys
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. This business was at Werrington before it was at St Marys, and there is a woman there who still has the original book. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: she is usually about in the afternoon
bring back whatever she is willing to say

quests.title: The Beecroft Pool
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Council has been saying the Beecroft pool is at end of life since the long weekend and the crack they keep pointing at is not in the shell. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the crack, close, with something for scale
an engineer can read that. A councillor cannot.

quests.title: The Petition Stall, Beecroft
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. We are running a stall for Beecroft on the long weekend and a stall needs $42 of gear that nobody has volunteered to pay for. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $42 and a table, if you see one
I will be there from eight either way

quests.title: Squad, Beecroft
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. I coach 89 kids at Beecroft at ten past five and three of them have stopped coming without anybody ringing me. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the flats where two of them live
take something with you, it is a long walk up
I do not need them back. I need to know.

quests.title: The Deep End, Beecroft
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. A group has been coming over the Beecroft fence after close and swimming in the dark, which is how Beecroft loses its pool. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the ones who go over the fence
the spot in the fence they use

quests.title: The Kiosk Freezer, Beecroft
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. The kiosk at Beecroft has a milk crate in it and a freezer that has been running warm since the long weekend. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: get two, we are going to be here
the plant room behind the kiosk
tell me whether it is the freezer or the power

quests.title: The Aquatic Centre, Beecroft
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. They want everyone from Beecroft to drive to the new centre at Cheltenham, so somebody should go and see whether it is any good. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: have a proper look, not a quick one
be honest with me, even if it is nice

quests.title: The Allawah Rank
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. The rank outside Allawah used to hold nine cars and since grand final week it holds four, and nobody will say who moved the line. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the painted line and the old one under it
the old paint is still there, that is the whole argument

quests.title: Lost Fares, Allawah
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Since the rank at Allawah shrank I am $50 a week down, and the association wants that number from somebody who can prove it. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $50 in a week, to show it can be done
that is the submission, right there

quests.title: Queue Jumpers, Allawah
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Cars that have never sat in the Allawah queue turn up at five in the morning and take the front of it, and the drivers who waited say nothing. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the ones who take the front
$33, which is about one airport run

quests.title: The Late Train, Allawah
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. When the last train into Allawah is late, 33 people come out at once and I have to have cars there before they do. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: come in on the last one from Carlton and see it
the rank at the moment the doors open

quests.title: The Door, Allawah
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. I have stood on this door near Allawah for 33 years and since grand final week somebody has been sending my guests to a different rank. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: follow one of them and see where they end up
you will be standing about, get something

quests.title: The Depot, Allawah
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The plates working the Allawah rank are dispatched from a depot at Hurstville, and the man who runs it has never met a driver he liked. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: go and be pleasant at him anyway
tell me whether he is the problem or the symptom
